observations.trace: Offline export checks world schema and final terrain purpose, selects a settlement and calls the dispatcher, writes scene input before optional stage and catalogue artifacts, and propagates errors. Its property-corner conversion uses expect outside tests. The inspection entrypoint has two selected playable/distant string producers, and may output an empty buildings array for unknown requested IDs.
observations.remaining: Accepted corner reachability, mission ID ownership, artifact transaction policy and the intended empty-selection coverage policy remain open; no export occurred.

observations.trace: Selected fixed-order stepped candidate is produced from typed front/court/rear elevations, encoded in Value, indexed by the inspection helper, readmitted by a checked named-level type, then consumed in support comparison before final report output.
observations.remaining: Exact aliases and all candidate/report owners remain open. No malformed candidate or actual support computation was run.

observations.trace: Playable footprint reports complete coverage from corner bounds while skipping rejected point/height samples. Vista footprint adds clipped area before checked height/point admission and performs playable clipping in local LOD coordinates while carrying an unshifted scene-centred playable half extent. This connects to the same original Adler shifted-seam finding already in the ledger.
observations.remaining: No concrete admitted input causing incomplete samples has been proved. Earlier independent evidence shows ordinary grounded reconstruction rejects shifted origins; other producers, diagnostic consumers and frame/alias policy remain open. Source tests with shifted origins were read, not run.

observations.trace: The selected helper requires one gate-crossing route and required source heights before emitting explicit endpoint-only feasibility; missing or ambiguous observations return None to the parent.
observations.remaining: Profile body, full geometry and actual route/acceptance policy remain open; endpoint grade is not complete gate, collision or traversal acceptance.

conditional_findings.first_contract: The current Rust guide prohibits expect outside tests; optional terrain-stage export must handle or represent accepted plot corners explicitly.
conditional_findings.source_witness: Capture::export_terrain_stages maps each property plot corner through ScenePlanPoint::from_metres(...).expect before calling ImportedTerrainCapture::sample_points. The same source bytes occur at95e.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: The selected main obtains its input through build_imported_scene and accepted plot data before optional stage export; actual invalid-corner reachability is not demonstrated. There is no product execution or crash observation.
conditional_findings.effect_and_limits: Repository rule finding and an unresolved admitted-corner contract, not an asserted operational incident. Exact plot admission, other callers and aliases remain open.
conditional_findings.repair_direction: When authorized, resolve the typed corner boundary without an outside-test expect while retaining sampling and meaningful error handling.
conditional_findings.alias_qualification: Original059 identifier and attribution preserved; distinct source/owner from the terrain-stage lookup rule finding, not a new historical unique finding or checkpoint3821 record.

conditional_findings.first_contract: An internal API should retain the semantic distinction between playable and distant building representations until its final diagnostic encoding.
conditional_findings.source_witness: The two selected main loops pass literal playable and distant strings to private inspect(representation: &str). The helper retains the argument while compiling geometry and measuring support, then places it in the final report JSON.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: The selected calls use only the two known literals and the string is not shown as a parsing branch or persisted gameplay authority. No wrong output or runtime behavior is demonstrated.
conditional_findings.effect_and_limits: A bounded private API ownership question, not evidence of malformed messages or a user incident. Global representation types and exact aliases remain unresolved.
conditional_findings.repair_direction: When authorized, assess a single appropriate closed representation owner through the private API and serialize only at the report boundary; preserve the separate BuildingLodLevel semantics.
conditional_findings.alias_qualification: Same original059 finding; no checkpoint3821 or extra historical unique finding asserted.

conditional_findings.first_contract: Keep named, admitted terrain candidate levels in semantic form across internal producer and consumer APIs until final report serialization.
conditional_findings.source_witness: terraces::compare builds finite SupportElevation front/court/rear levels into a Value with two ordered candidates, with the stepped candidate second. Inspection::terrace_comparison indexes candidates[1].front_court_rear_elevations_m, calls ProposedCompoundLevels::from_capture, and supplies the decoded named fields to solutions::compare for support planning before final report export.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: The selected producer fixes the second candidate as stepped, and the consumer checks exactly three values and readmits finite SupportElevation values. No malformed private data, selection failure or gameplay incident is asserted; native final JSON is intentional.
conditional_findings.effect_and_limits: A recovered producer-migration and ownership finding. Its current exact chain is source-proven, but global owners, all report consumers and exact aliases remain open.
conditional_findings.repair_direction: When authorized, propagate named levels and semantic candidate selection through internal operations, then encode the final diagnostic report without preserving the private JSON reparse as an API.
conditional_findings.alias_qualification: The original059 identifier, historic own-lens reused sources and author remain distinct from new95e traces; no checkpoint3821 or historical count increment.
